text:
lina-cs: Quick heads-up 12: Meridian renewal due next week. Procurement wants to split payment across two entities and requests a seat-credit if they reduce seats mid-term. They also want wire instructions on the invoice. Need legal + finance + billing input before I send addendum.

omar-acct: Numbers please 12: current ARR and seats, proposed term?

lina-cs: Current ARR $33,600 (240 seats). Customer wants 12mo term but to invoice 50% to parent (Meridian Holdings) and 50% to a corporate sister (Meridian Ops). No discount requested. They want a "seat-reduction credit" allowing one mid-term true-down at month 6 with a 60% credit of unused months.

rita-legal: Split-billing is usually ok but need to capture which entity signs and who is liable. We must have both entities expressly accept billing responsibility for their share; otherwise revenue recognition and collections get messy. For seat-credit, legal prefers a fixed formula; 60% credit language is OK if finance confirms accounting impact. Also require PO numbers and named delegates for delegated-signer.

vivian-finance: From finance: Split invoices okay if we map two billing entities and two subscriptions or create split invoice lines with separate remit-to fields. We'll need both legal names + TAX IDs. The proposed 60% credit is an unusual concession; finance prefers 50% to simplify. If we keep 60% we must accept some revenue erosion and update forecasts. Also: wiring on invoice is fine but we should avoid publishing full bank details in the contract; prefer invoice-only wiring instructions with KYC verification step.

ken-billing: Operationally, our billing system doesn't support a single subscription split across two remit-to entities. Options: (1) create two linked subscriptions each billing their share, or (2) create one invoice with two separate remit-to lines (manual process). Option (1) takes ~24-48h setup but is cleaner. We also support adding PO number per-line if provided. Need both entity details and PO numbers to proceed.

lina-cs: Customer provided details: Meridian Holdings Inc (EIN 11-1111111) and Meridian Ops LLC (EIN 22-2222222). Procurement will provide two PO numbers after we include split-billing language.

omar-acct: If we go with two subscriptions, pricing per-seat stays the same. We should confirm seat allocation between entities now to avoid disputes later.

rita-legal: I'll draft a short addendum: (1) split-billing instructions and obligation allocation, (2) seat-reduction credit formula (we'll template both 50% and 60% versions for finance), (3) PO/IKYC/wire instruction handling clause. Will post in-thread for redline.

vivian-finance: Please template both credit options. Finance leans to 50% but can approve 60% if leadership signs off. Also require credit-app if combined exposure >$50k; this account is under threshold but borderline if they prepay any portion.

ken-billing: I'll provision a billing ops ticket for creating two linked subscriptions pending approvals. That will add a 1 business day lead. If customer needs immediate invoicing, we can issue a one-off manual invoice.

docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope 1795556950 "Meridian Split-Billing Addendum" created and awaiting legal draft.

lina-cs: Plan: 1) Rita posts addendum draft by EOD; 2) Finance picks credit option and confirms credit-app need; 3) Billing tickets created to split subscriptions if approved; 4) Send DocuSign once legal + finance confirm. I'll mark renewal as "at-risk" in Gainsight if DocuSign not launched within 48h.

omar-acct: Agree. If procurement pushes a single PO across both entities, escalate.

lina-cs: Thanks team 12. I'll loop back with redline and PO updates.
